title: Support Apache ECharts natively
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

The [streamlit-echarts](https://github.com/andfanilo/streamlit-echarts) custom component is quite popular and echarts provides a [huge number of chart types](https://echarts.apache.org/examples/en/index.html) complementing plotly & vega charts. Unfortunately, [streamlit-echarts](https://github.com/andfanilo/streamlit-echarts) isn't maintained anymore. Maybe we should add echarts support natively as `st.echarts_chart`?

### Why?

_No response_

### How?

_No response_

### Additional Context

- There is also a popular python API for creating echarts: https://github.com/pyecharts/pyecharts

## Update

Native Apache ECharts support via `st.echarts_chart` is coming in 1.64+.

```python
import streamlit as st

st.echarts_chart(
    {
        "xAxis": {"type": "category", "data": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]},
        "yAxis": {"type": "value"},
        "series": [{"type": "bar", "data": [5, 20, 36, 10, 10]}],
    }
)
```
